1192144950961606656.a: I was concerned the DC-DC boost would cause noise in the receiver. No issues, just the usual Ethernet noises floating through the sky. Next up: Replace the dead incandescent tube lamp with LEDs. Replace 1/8" phono jack shortwave antenna port with SMA; 1/8" has never worked well.

1192146049357549568.a: 18650 cells are salvaged from a 2007 laptop battery. They were at self-discharge and the pack had self-terminated for safety. No issues putting them on a dedicated charger and bringing them up to 3.7V. Don't discharge a Li-Ion and leave it that way! DC boards ~$1 from Amazon.
